| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Octaves** `octaves` | 4 | 1 to 4 | The number of octaves. Each one doubles the filter sizes, from 9 to 27 px in the first to 51 to 195 px in the fourth. |
| **Threshold** `threshold` | 0.005 | 0.0001 to 0.1 | The smallest box-filter Hessian determinant a keypoint needs, for an image from 0 to 1. |
| **Orientation** `orientation` | on | On or off | Give each keypoint an orientation from Haar wavelet responses. Off gives every keypoint the angle 0, as upright SURF does. |
